 -----Original Message-----  
From: 	oscar.miles@broadstoneinvest.com@cedarpointcap.com  
Sent:	Thursday, November 7, 2024 4:57 PM  
To:	Burgess, James  
Subject:	Updated Partnership Agreement  

James,  

Finally, attached are the updated agreements, both redlined and clean versions. I've arranged for execution copies to be signed by the various Broadstone entities, which are now being delivered to Mr. Joshua in your Deal Team for signing on behalf of Cedar Point entities. I've also prepared guarantee agreements from Broadstone Holdings and Cedar Point, each duly executed or acknowledged on behalf of Broadstone. The leadership’s stance was that this final draft is "take it or leave it" for Cedar Point.  

Key changes include:  

1. Removal of all margining clauses and collateral references.  
2. Inclusion of all operating subsidiaries.  
3. The Group payment mechanism was removed from Section 4 due to ambiguity over the paying party.  

Thanks,  

Oscar  

(See attached file: CedarPoint Partnership Agrmt 11-8.doc)(See attached file: CedarPoint Partnership Agrmt 11-8 Broadstone)
